panels.description: OS Taskbar navigation and CSS theme.

panels.title: ◈ ALERTS & ACTIVE INCIDENTS
panels.description: Currently firing alerts from Grafana unified alerting.

panels.title: ◉ Power Cost Estimation (THB/day)

targets.rawSql: WITH power_data AS (SELECT device_id, AVG(power_watt) AS avg_watts FROM public.ldi_metrics WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day' AND power_watt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY device_id) SELECT 'Fleet Power Cost' AS metric, ROUND(SUM(avg_watts * 24 * 4.5 / 1000)::NUMERIC, 0) AS value FROM power_data

panels.description: Estimated daily power cost in Thai Baht based on average LDI power consumption × 24 hours × 4.5 THB/kWh.

panels.title: ◈ TOP 10 CRITICAL NODES

targets.rawSql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT device_id, cpu_load_percent, temp_c, time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='server' AND enabled=true)) SELECT r.device_id AS "Server Name", CASE WHEN r.time > NOW() - INTERVAL '2.5 minutes' THEN 'online' WHEN r.time > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' THEN 'stale' ELSE 'offline' END AS "Status", ROUND(r.cpu_load_percent::NUMERIC, 1) AS "CPU (%)", ROUND(r.temp_c::NUMERIC, 0) AS "Temp (°C)" FROM ranked r WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY r.time DESC LIMIT 10

panels.description: Real-time fleet status table showing each machine's CPU, RAM, disk, temperature, network, and LDI health. Click machine name to drill down.

panels.title: ◈ CPU Load (Fleet Envelope)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', bucket) AS time, 'Fleet Average' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(avg_cpu)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='server' AND enabled=true) GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, 'Fleet Average' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(cpu_load_percent)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND time > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket) FROM public.sys_hourly), NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='server' AND enabled=true) GROUP BY time_bucket('1 hour', time) ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', bucket) AS time, 'Peak Machine' AS metric, ROUND(MAX(avg_cpu)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='server' AND enabled=true) GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, 'Peak Machine' AS metric, ROUND(MAX(cpu_load_percent)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND time > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket) FROM public.sys_hourly), NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='server' AND enabled=true) GROUP BY time_bucket('1 hour', time) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Fleet-wide cpu load envelope: average (solid cyan) vs worst-case ceiling (dashed #EF4444).

panels.title: ◈ Temperature (Fleet Envelope)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', bucket) AS time, 'Fleet Average' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(max_temp)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='server' AND enabled=true) AND max_temp > 0 GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, 'Fleet Average' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(temp_c)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND time > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket) FROM public.sys_hourly), NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='server' AND enabled=true) AND temp_c > 0 GROUP BY time_bucket('1 hour', time) ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', bucket) AS time, 'Hottest Machine' AS metric, ROUND(MAX(max_temp)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='server' AND enabled=true) AND max_temp > 0 GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, 'Hottest Machine' AS metric, ROUND(MAX(temp_c)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND time > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket) FROM public.sys_hourly), NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='server' AND enabled=true) AND temp_c > 0 GROUP BY time_bucket('1 hour', time) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Fleet-wide temperature envelope: average (solid cyan) vs worst-case ceiling (dashed #EF4444).

panels.title: ◈ Network Throughput (All Machines)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  device_id AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_rx)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "RX (Mbps)"
FROM public.net_hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  device_id AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_tx)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "TX (Mbps)"
FROM public.net_hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.description: Network throughput (Mbps) for all machines. Download (positive) and Upload (negative-Y axis) per interface.

panels.title: ◈ RAM Saturation (Fleet Envelope)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', bucket) AS time, 'Fleet Average' AS metric, ROUND((AVG(avg_ram_used / NULLIF(avg_ram_total, 0) * 100))::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='server' AND enabled=true) GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, 'Fleet Average' AS metric, ROUND((AVG(ram_used_mb / NULLIF(ram_total_mb, 0) * 100))::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND time > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket) FROM public.sys_hourly), NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='server' AND enabled=true) GROUP BY time_bucket('1 hour', time) ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', bucket) AS time, 'Worst Machine' AS metric, ROUND((MAX(avg_ram_used / NULLIF(avg_ram_total, 0) * 100))::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='server' AND enabled=true) GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, 'Worst Machine' AS metric, ROUND((MAX(ram_used_mb / NULLIF(ram_total_mb, 0) * 100))::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND time > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket) FROM public.sys_hourly), NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='server' AND enabled=true) GROUP BY time_bucket('1 hour', time) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Fleet-wide ram saturation envelope: average (solid cyan) vs worst-case ceiling (dashed #EF4444).
